name: hold-to-confirm-button
title: Hold to confirm button
description: A destructive action you have to hold to trigger: a fill runs across the button, releasing early cancels, and a keyboard and screen reader path exists.
docs: onConfirm runs once. A quick press is the other way in: it says "Press again to confirm" and a second press within three seconds confirms. Keep label honest about the gesture ("Hold to delete project"); the button is as wide as its longest state.
